description: Takes your own list with one row per topic (topic, role or person in charge, deputy, value limit in euros, contact) and optionally a question and an amount. Returns the entries that match the question, who may sign the amount (the lowest limit that covers it), a notice sorted by topic, the signing ladder, and the gaps: two people in charge of the same topic and an amount above every limit (red), topics without a deputy and one person carrying more than 40 percent of the topics (yellow). Deterministic keyword matching, no AI, nothing stored. It only uses your list and invents no names. To check a full approval matrix against a people list use check_approval_matrix, for a RASCI matrix use check_rasci_matrix. Licence, or one free check every 30 days.

amount_eur.description: Optional: the amount in euros that needs a signature.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

question.description: Optional: the question in plain words, for example who signs a framework contract.

rows.description: One row per topic: topic, responsible, deputy, limit (euros), contact. German column names work too (thema, zustaendig, vertretung, grenze, kontakt).

name: find_responsible
title: Who is responsible: from your own list of topics, people in charge, deputies and value limits, the answer to who to ask and who may sign, with a notice and the gaps
